title: Choose the hybrid composition
question: All three use Mashrabiya daylight with a parametric Arabic counterseal. Choose the composition that should become the web and mobile build.

options.label: Daylight-led conversation
options.lineage: Mashrabiya daylight with a compact unresolved counterseal
options.thesis: The invoice is the luminous hinge inside the conversation.
options.viewport: Chat leads; the €6,000 invoice and Review payment options bridge become the dominant center object.
options.risk: The generated SANAD insight contains a factual claim that will be replaced with the existing neutral product copy.

options.label: Counterseal cost axis
options.lineage: A bilateral payer/recipient instrument organized by the counterseal
options.thesis: The shared consequence is the page: supplier receipt and buyer outlay meet at the seal.
options.viewport: Finance leads with routes above and the buyer/supplier consequence axis as the focal moment.
options.risk: This is the densest option and needs disciplined scaling on smaller phones.

options.label: Continuous shared folio
options.lineage: One porcelain sheet from invoice to signed agreement
options.thesis: The entire decision reads as one continuous bilingual folio, with the seal showing progress rather than decorating the page.
options.viewport: Finance uses one continuous sheet with exact totals, stacked routes, fee ownership, and a closing agreement action.
options.risk: The generated comp over-labels all routes as simulations; the build will keep that label only on USDC and retain the existing synthetic-source disclosure.
